articles.summary: Our new digital children’s book, Alexander’s Not-So-Secret Diary, brings this belief to life through the experiences of nine-year-old Alexander, who is living with Alexander disease (AxD), an ultra-rare, progressive and often fatal neurological disorder that affects approximately 1 in 1 to 3 million people worldwide.
articles.title: New Digital Children’s Book, Alexander’s Not-So-Secret Diary, Now Available

articles.summary: More than three million people in the United States are living with very high triglycerides 500 mg/dL or higher, also known as severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG), yet many are left to navigate a complex care journey largely on their own. With support from Ionis, the Hidden in Plain Sight white paper was developed in partnership with the National Triglyceride Alliance, leading clinicians, patient advocates, people living with very high triglycerides and their care partners to examine the gap between recognition and care and the collective action required to close it.
articles.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Four Takeaways on Addressing the Unseen Burden of Very High Triglycerides
